message.content:
Based on my search, here are the login options for PreLicenseTraining:

## Student Login
The main student login portal is available at:
**https://prelicensetraining.com/login**

To log in, you'll need to enter your login name and password. Your login name may be your email address unless you specified otherwise during registration.

## Mentor/Recruiter Login
If you are a mentor, recruiter, or company representative, you can log in at:
- **https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login**
- **https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login**

## Forgot Password
If you've forgotten your password, you can reset it at:
**https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword**

---

**Note:** PreLicenseTraining.com provides online insurance pre-licensing and continuing education courses with streaming video instruction, online textbooks, practice exams, and a virtual testing center called StudyHall.

4. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword
